blind.description: The model is an ornate architectural flying buttress section consisting of a tall upright square pier on the right and a thick curved half-arch sweeping down to a lower stepped footing on the left, leaving a clear open space beneath. The tall pier features a flat square capital, stepped plinth base, recessed green-and-gold panels, and relief carvings showing a balanced scales motif above three stacked coins. Both flanks of the arch rib are adorned with a row of circular gold coins standing on edge, and the spine of the arch is composed of segmented gold blocks. Surfaces are solid, thick, and continuous with no floating, melted, or shattered geometry. It stands directly on its own two integrated rectangular plinths with flat undersides resting flush on the floor, with no added base slab. The palette is antique gold and deep emerald green. There are no plain black or unpainted areas and no flame or glow, though a bright red seam artifact is visible where the arch joins the pier. (No text or labels appear on any of the renders.)
blind.from_above: From straight above (tile C), it appears as an elongated linear structure: a large flat square gold capital at the top, a smaller stepped square plinth at the bottom, and the segmented gold spine of the arch connecting them. A bright red horizontal seam line is visible at the upper junction between arch and pillar. The curved arch profile and open underpass are clearly reflected in the cast shadow.
